build_subword_nmt_bpe_encoder: build a SubwordNMTBPE encoder from a config with bpe_codes path and separator to tokenize text
encode_text_with_bpe: encode a string using the SubwordNMTBPE encode method to apply BPE tokenization with merge codes
decode_bpe_tokenized_text: decode BPE tokenized text by removing the bpe_symbol separator and stripping trailing whitespace
review_subword_nmt_config: review the SubwordNMTBPEConfig dataclass to understand bpe_codes and bpe_separator default field values
test_bpe_encode_decode_roundtrip: test the SubwordNMTBPE encode and decode methods to verify roundtrip text tokenization and detokenization
